deathmatch.description: Most kills wins. With teams on, every kill counts for your team, so stick together.

elimination.description: No respawns. The last one standing takes the round (or the last team, with teams on).

gun_game.description: Each kill moves you to the next weapon; a kill with the last one wins. With teams on, the team moves up together.

juggernaut.description: One fighter is the Juggernaut: red, 500 health, 200 shield. Whoever kills the Juggernaut becomes it.

king_of_the_hill.name: King of the Hill
king_of_the_hill.description: Score a point for every second your side alone holds the hill. With more than one zone, the hill moves now and then.

domination.description: Stand in a zone to capture it. Every zone your team holds earns points over time.

territories.description: Capture the zone next to yours to push toward the enemy's end. Hold every zone to score; then the line resets.

capture_the_flag.name: Capture the Flag
capture_the_flag.description: Bring an enemy flag to your own while yours is home. A dropped flag returns after 15 seconds, or when its team touches it.
